data.title: Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) – red light violation, €232.00
data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle (fine office) of Landkreis Musteruckermark issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) against Ronny Musterspree for running a red light (vehicle UM-RS 404) on 17 October 2026 in Musterprenzlau. The total amount due is €232.00 (fine €200.00 plus fee €28.50 and delivery costs €3.50), and a point is recorded in the driving register (Fahreignungsregister).
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice for a traffic offence (running a red light). You may file an objection (Einspruch) if you disagree, and the app will show until when based on the delivery date shown on the enclosed delivery certificate. If you do nothing, the notice becomes final and the total amount (€232.00) becomes payable two weeks after that happens — the exact date is not yet fixed since it depends on whether you object. If you don't pay once it is final, enforcement measures can follow. Consider getting legal advice (e.g. a traffic lawyer or ADAC) if you want to contest the fine or the point.

remedy.quote: Einspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist zulässig. Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung beim Landkreis Musteruckermark – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
